name: Ịghọta LLM na Nka Ide Prompt
objectives: Mgbe e nyere gị azịza chatbot ezighi ezi mana o ji n'aka, ịkọwa otu token, prediction na context window nwere ike ime ka LLM dị ka o kwuru eziokwu ma ka mehie, n'okwu nke gị, na-akpọ opekata mpe ihe abụọ kpatara ya
Maka otu ọrụ n'ime agent gị, ide system prompt nwere role, ọrụ a ga-arụ, context, iwu na ụdị azịza, nke akụkụ ọ bụla dị n'ime ya, iwu ya nwekwara ike ịlele
Mgbe e nyere gị system prompt gị, itinye otu ọmụmaatụ zuru ezu na ụdị azịza JSON kpọmkwem, nke mere na opekata mpe 4 n'ime azịza 5 bụ naanị JSON ziri ezi nwere keys ziri ezi
N'ime notebook Google Colab n'efu, ịkpọ LLM site na Python, na igodo API echekwara dị ka secret, ebe e bipụtara azịza ahụ, igodo ọ bụla adịghịkwa n'ime koodu
Mgbe e nyere gị azịza model n'ime notebook gị, ịgbanwe azịza JSON ka ọ bụrụ data Python ma jikwaa azịza ọjọọ, n'enweghị koodu ịgbaji n'azịza efu ma ọ bụ nke mebiri emebi
Mgbe e nyere gị ihe nnwale ise, gụnyere otu nke nwere aghụghọ, ịnwale prompt ahụ, idekọ nsonaazụ ya ma gbanwee otu ihe iji dozie ọdịda, na-arụghachi nnwale niile mgbe mgbanwe ọ bụla gasịrị

chapters.name: Isi 1: Otu LLM si arụ ọrụ na otu esi enye ya ntụziaka

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Otu LLM si ede ihe: token, prediction na context
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kọwaa ihe mere LLM ji nwee ike ịdị ka o kwuru eziokwu ma ka mehie.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị azịza chatbot ezighi ezi mana o ji n'aka, ị ga-enwe ike ịkọwa otu token, prediction na context window nwere ike ime ka LLM dị ka o kwuru eziokwu ma ka mehie, n'okwu nke gị, na-akpọ opekata mpe ihe abụọ kpatara ya.
LLM na-ede otu obere ihe n'otu oge. A na-akpọ obere ihe ndị a token: okwu mkpụmkpụ, akụkụ nke okwu ogologo, ma ọ bụ akara edemede. N'nzọụkwụ ọ bụla, model ahụ na-ebu amụma (predict) token ọzọ nwere ike ịbịa, site n'ihe niile ọ hụrụ ruo ugbu a.
Ihe niile model ahụ nwere ike ịhụ n'otu oge bụ context window ya: system prompt, mkparịta ụka ahụ, akwụkwọ ọ bụla i tinyere na azịza nke ya ruo ugbu a. Ihe ọ bụla dị n'èzí context window adịghị adị nye model ahụ. O nweghị ncheta mkparịta ụka gara aga belụsọ na app ahụ tinyere ha.
Ebe ọ na-ebu amụma ederede nwere ike ịbịa, LLM nwere ike ide azịza dị mma ịgụ mana ọ bụ ụgha. Ọ naghị achọ eziokwu belụsọ ma o nwere ngwaọrụ nchọta (search tool). Prompt gị, context i nyere ya na nlele i wuru bụ ihe na-eme ka a pụrụ ịtụkwasị ya obi.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Token: obere ihe ederede, nke na-abụkarị akụkụ okwu, nke LLM na-agụ ma na-ede.
- Context window: ederede niile model ahụ nwere ike ịhụ n'otu oge.
- Prediction (amụma): model ahụ na-ahọrọ token ọzọ nwere ike ịbịa site n'ihe bu ya ụzọ.
Nwaa ugbu a: Na chatbot n'efu, jụọ: "How many letters r are in the word strawberry? Then explain how tokens might make this hard for you." Dee ma azịza mbụ ahụ ziri ezi, na ihe mere token ji dị mkpa.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkọwa token na context window, na ihe mere e ji ekwesị ilele LLM.

check.q: Gịnị ka LLM na-eme mgbe ọ na-ede azịza?
options: Ọ na-achọ azịza ahụ n'ebe nchekwa data e lelere
Ọ na-ebu amụma token ọzọ nwere ike ịbịa, otu n'otu
Ọ na-edetuo azịza mmadụ dere chekwaa
Ọ na-achọ n'ịntanetị ma gụọ azịza mbụ
check.why: LLM na-ebu amụma ederede token n'otu n'otu, ya mere ọ nwere ike ịdị mma ịgụ n'eleleghị eziokwu.

check.q: Chatbot nyere azịza o ji n'aka gbasara iwu dị mkpa n'ọrụ gị. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Jiri ya, n'ihi na ọ dị ka o ji n'aka
Jụọ ya otu ajụjụ ahụ ọzọ ruo mgbe o kwenyere
Lelee iwu ahụ n'isi iyi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi tupu i jiri ya
Tinye azịza ahụ na mkparịta ụka ọhụrụ ka ọ kwado ya
check.why: Azịza dị mma ịgụ ka nwere ike ịbụ ihe ezighi ezi, ya mere eziokwu dị mkpa chọrọ isi iyi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Akụkụ nke prompt siri ike
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Dee prompt nwere role, ọrụ a ga-arụ, context, iwu na ụdị azịza.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Maka otu ọrụ n'ime agent gị, ị ga-enwe ike ide system prompt nwere role, ọrụ a ga-arụ, context, iwu na ụdị azịza, nke akụkụ ọ bụla dị n'ime ya, iwu ya nwekwara ike ịlele.
Prompt siri ike maka agent nwere akụkụ ise. Role: onye model ahụ bụ ("You sort customer messages for a small bakery."). Ọrụ (task): otu ọrụ ahụ. Context: eziokwu ọ chọrọ. Iwu: ihe o kwesịrị ime na ihe o kwesịghị ime. Ụdị azịza (output format): kpọmkwem otu azịza ahụ ga-adị.
System prompt na-ejide akụkụ ndị na-anọgide otu ihe ahụ oge ọ bụla: role, iwu na ụdị azịza. User message na-ejide ihe na-agbanwe oge ọ bụla: ozi ọhụrụ a ga-ekewa, ajụjụ ọhụrụ.
Kwuo kpọmkwem ma kwuo ihe a ga-eme. "Zaa n'ahịrịokwu abụọ" na-arụ ọrụ karịa "agala ogologo". Kwuo ihe a ga-eme mgbe o nweghị n'aka: "If the message fits no category, use other." Otu iwu ahụ na-egbochi ọtụtụ nchepụta ezighi ezi.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Role: onye bụ model ahụ?
- Ọrụ: otu ọrụ doro anya.
- Context: eziokwu ọ chọrọ.
- Iwu: ihe ọ ga-eme, ihe ọ gaghị eme, na ihe ọ ga-eme mgbe o nweghị n'aka.
- Ụdị azịza: kpọmkwem otu azịza ahụ ga-adị.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- System prompt: ntụziaka na-adịgide adịgide a na-eziga n'arịrịọ ọ bụla.
- User message: akụkụ na-agbanwe oge ọ bụla, dị ka ajụjụ ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ ihe ọhụrụ e tinyere.
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee system prompt nwere akụkụ ise maka otu ọrụ n'ime agent gị site n'ihe ọmụmụ 1. Tinye ya na chatbot n'efu, wee zipu ihe atọ dị iche iche ma lee ma ọ na-agbaso iwu ọ bụla.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ide prompt nwere role, ọrụ a ga-arụ, context, iwu na ụdị azịza.

check.q: Gịnị bụ akụkụ role nke system prompt?
options: Kpọmkwem keys JSON ị chọrọ ka o weghachi
Ozi onye ọrụ zitere oge a
Ndepụta ihe nnwale
Onye model ahụ kwesịrị ịbụ, dị ka onye na-ekewa ozi ndị ahịa
check.why: Role na-agwa model ahụ onye ọ bụ maka ọrụ a; akụkụ ndị ọzọ na-ekpuchi ọrụ, context, iwu na ụdị azịza.

check.q: Prompt gị na-ekwu "be helpful and good" azịza ya na-adịkwa iche iche. Gịnị ka ị ga-agbanwe?
options: Were iwu doro anya model ahụ nwere ike ịgbaso, nke ị nwere ike ilele, dochie ya
Mee ka prompt ahụ dị ogologo karị site n'okwu ọma ndị ọzọ
Wepụ iwu niile ka model ahụ kpebie
Gbanwee gaa na chatbot ọzọ
check.why: A pụghị ilele okwu na-edoghị anya; iwu doro anya na-eme ka àgwà ya bụrụ otu.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Ọmụmaatụ, nzọụkwụ na azịza hazịrị ahazi
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Jiri ọmụmaatụ na ụdị JSON nweta azịza mmemme kọmputa nwere ike ịgụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị system prompt gị, ị ga-enwe ike itinye otu ọmụmaatụ zuru ezu na ụdị azịza JSON kpọmkwem, nke mere na opekata mpe 4 n'ime azịza 5 bụ naanị JSON ziri ezi nwere keys ziri ezi.
Igosi ka mma karịa ịkọ. Otu ma ọ bụ ọmụmaatụ abụọ zuru ezu n'ime prompt (ihe e tinyere na kpọmkwem azịza ị chọrọ) na-eme ka nsonaazụ ka mma nke ukwuu. A na-akpọ nke a few-shot prompting. Zero-shot pụtara na ọ dịghị ọmụmaatụ.
Agent chọrọ azịza koodu nwere ike ịgụ, ọ bụghị paragraf mkparịta ụka. Rịọ maka JSON, ụdị ederede dị mfe nwere aha na uru ha: {"category": "order", "urgent": false}. Kwuo: "Reply with only JSON, no other text," ma gosi kpọmkwem keys ahụ.
Maka ọrụ siri ike karị, rịọ model ahụ ka ọ rụọ ya nzọụkwụ n'nzọụkwụ: buru ụzọ depụta eziokwu, wee kpebie. Ọtụtụ ọrụ model nwekwara ike ịmanye JSON ziri ezi site na ntọala a na-akpọ structured output; lelee akwụkwọ nkọwa (documentation) nke onye na-enye gị ọrụ ahụ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Few-shot prompting: inye model ahụ ọmụmaatụ ole na ole nke ihe e tinyere na azịza ziri ezi.
- JSON: ụdị ederede dị mfe nwere uru nwere aha, nke mmemme kọmputa nwere ike ịgụ, dị ka {"name": "Ana"}.
- Structured output: ntọala model na-eme ka azịza ya soro kpọmkwem ụdị e nyere.
Nwaa ugbu a: Tinye otu ọmụmaatụ zuru ezu na ụdị JSON na prompt gị site na Nkuzi 2. Zipu ihe ise. Gụọ ole n'ime azịza ndị ahụ bụ naanị JSON nwere keys ziri ezi.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike iji ọmụmaatụ na ụdị JSON nweta azịza koodu gị nwere ike ịgụ.

check.q: Gịnị mere ị ga-eji tinye ọmụmaatụ zuru ezu na prompt?
options: Ọ na-eme ka model ahụ rụọ ọrụ ngwa ngwa
Ọ na-ezo iwu ahụ n'anya onye ọrụ
Ọ na-egosi model ahụ kpọmkwem ụdị azịza ị chọrọ
Ọ na-eme ka role ghara ịdị mkpa
check.why: Ọmụmaatụ na-egosi model ahụ usoro na ụdị ọ ga-eṅomi.

check.q: Ụfọdụ azịza na-alọta dị ka JSON nwere ahịrịokwu enyi n'ihu ya. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Nabata ya, n'ihi na JSON dị n'ime ya ebe ụfọdụ
Kwuo na prompt ka o weghachi naanị JSON nwere kpọmkwem keys ahụ, ma gosi ọmụmaatụ
Rịọ maka azịza dị ogologo karị
Wepụ ụdị azịza ka model ahụ nwere onwe ya
check.why: Koodu chọrọ naanị JSON, ya mere prompt ga-ekwurịrị ya n'ụzọ doro anya ma gosi ya.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Ịkpọ na ịnwale LLM site na Python

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Oku model mbụ gị site na Google Colab
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Kpọọ LLM site na notebook Python ma bipụta azịza ya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: N'ime notebook Google Colab n'efu, ị ga-enwe ike ịkpọ LLM site na Python, na igodo API echekwara dị ka secret, ebe e bipụtara azịza ahụ, igodo ọ bụla adịghịkwa n'ime koodu.
Google Colab bụ notebook Python n'efu na-arụ ọrụ na browser gị; ị chọrọ akaụntụ Google. A naghị ekwe nkwa ihe ọ na-enye n'efu, notebook a hapụrụ n'arụghị ọrụ na-akwụsịkwa (time out), ya mere chekwaa ọrụ gị. Meghee colab.research.google.com ma mepụta notebook ọhụrụ.
Iji kpọọ model, ị chọrọ igodo API (API key), okwuntughe nzuzo maka mmemme kọmputa. Gemini API nke Google nwere ọkwa n'efu (free tier) maka obere ọrụ; ị na-enweta igodo site na Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com/apikey). Google kwuru na ihe e zitere na free tier nwere ike iji meziwanye ngwaahịa ya, ya mere ezitela ozi nzuzo ma ọ bụ ozi ndị ahịa na free tier mgbe ọ bụla.
Quickstart nke Google ugbu a na-egosi ahịrị dị ka ndị a: pip install -U google-genai, wee from google import genai, client = genai.Client(), wee interaction = client.interactions.create(model='MODEL_NAME', input='Explain an AI agent in one sentence'), wee print(interaction.output_text). Detuo kpọmkwem aha model na koodu site na peeji quickstart ahụ, n'ihi na aha na koodu na-agbanwe. A na-agụ igodo ahụ site na environment variable aha ya bụ GEMINI_API_KEY.
Etinyela igodo gị na notebook a na-ekesa, foto ihuenyo ma ọ bụ chatbot mgbe ọ bụla. Debe ya na ntọala nzuzo (secret), ma mee igodo ọhụrụ ma ọ bụrụ na otu apụta. Ndị ọzọ na-enye ọrụ a (OpenAI, Anthropic, ma ọ bụ model n'efu dị na kọmputa gị site na Ollama) na-arụ ọrụ otu ụzọ ahụ: client, aha model, ihe e tinyere na azịza.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Meghee colab.research.google.com ma mee notebook ọhụrụ.
- Nweta igodo API site na Google AI Studio ma debe ya na nzuzo.
- Wụnye library ahụ ma detuo koodu quickstart.
- Jiri aha model e gosiri na peeji quickstart.
- Rụọ cell ahụ ma bipụta azịza ya.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- API: ụzọ otu mmemme kọmputa si agwa ibe ya okwu, dị ka koodu gị na-arịọ model azịza.
- Igodo API (API key): koodu nzuzo na-ekwe ka mmemme gị jiri otu ọrụ; were ya dị ka okwuntughe.
- Environment variable: ntọala echekwara n'èzí koodu gị, a na-ejikarị maka ihe nzuzo.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- Google Colab FAQ
- Gemini API quickstart
- Gemini API pricing and free tier
Nwaa ugbu a: Mee notebook Colab, debe igodo n'ụzọ n'enweghị nsogbu ma mee ka model ahụ zaa: "Explain an AI agent in one sentence." Chekwaa notebook ahụ dị ka agent-prompts.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkpọ LLM site na Python na notebook n'efu ma debe igodo API gị na nzuzo.

options: Notebook Python n'efu na-arụ ọrụ na web browser
Model AI a na-akwụ ụgwọ
Ebe a na-echekwa okwuntughe
App ekwentị maka ịkparịta ụka na AI
check.why: Colab na-ekwe ka ị rụọ Python na browser n'efu, nwere oke.

check.q: Ị na-achọ ikesa notebook gị. E dere igodo API gị n'ime cell koodu. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Kesaa ya, ebe ọ bụ naanị ndị enyi ga-ahụ ya
Mee ka igodo ahụ ghara ịhụ anya na foto ihuenyo kama
Gbanwee aha variable ahụ ka o siere ike ịchọta
Bugharịa igodo ahụ gaa na ntọala nzuzo, ma mee igodo ọhụrụ ma ọ bụrụ na a hụlarị ya
check.why: Igodo dị ka okwuntughe: debe ya na ntọala nzuzo ma dochie ya ma ọ bụrụ na ọ pụtara.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Iziga system prompt gị na ịgụ JSON na koodu
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Zipu prompt gị site na koodu ma gbanwee azịza JSON ka ọ bụrụ data Python.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị azịza model n'ime notebook gị, ị ga-enwe ike ịgbanwe azịza JSON ka ọ bụrụ data Python ma jikwaa azịza ọjọọ, n'enweghị koodu ịgbaji n'azịza efu ma ọ bụ nke mebiri emebi.
Tinye system prompt gị n'ime variable Python: SYSTEM = '''You sort messages for a bakery... Reply with only JSON.''' Tinye ihe ọhụrụ ọ bụla n'ime variable ọzọ. Ụzọ kacha mfe isi jikọta ha bụ iziga SYSTEM na ihe ahụ dị ka otu ederede; ọtụtụ ndị na-enye ọrụ nwekwara ntọala system-instruction dị iche, nke e gosiri n'akwụkwọ nkọwa ha.
Gụọ azịza ahụ site na library json nke Python: import json, wee data = json.loads(text). Ugbu a data['category'] bụ uru Python nkịtị agent gị nwere ike iji rụọ ọrụ.
Mgbe ụfọdụ, model ahụ ga-etinye okwu gburugburu JSON ma ọ bụ hapụ otu key. Kwadebe maka ya: tinye parse ahụ n'ime try na except, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ daa, ma ọ bụ nwaa ọzọ otu ugboro site na "Reply with only JSON" ma ọ bụ kaa ihe ahụ akara dị ka nke dara. Ekwela ka azịza ọjọọ mee ka agent ahụ gbajie ma ọ bụ gafere n'enweghị onye hụrụ ya.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Chekwaa system prompt n'ime variable.
- Zipu system prompt na ihe e tinyere nye model ahụ.
- Parse azịza ahụ site na json.loads n'ime try / except.
- Lelee na keys ị chọrọ dị ya.
- Ọ bụrụ na ọ daa: nwaa ọzọ otu ugboro, ma ọ bụ kaa ya akara na ọ dara.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Parse: ịgbanwe ederede ka ọ bụrụ data mmemme kọmputa nwere ike iji.
- try / except: ụzọ Python si ejide mperi ma jikwaa ya kama ịgbaji.
- Retry (ịnwa ọzọ): ịnwa otu arịrịọ ahụ ọzọ mgbe ọ dara.
Nwaa ugbu a: N'ime notebook gị, zipu system prompt gị na otu ihe, parse JSON ahụ, ma bipụta naanị category. Wee nye ya ihe dị iche (ozi efu) ma hụ na koodu gị agbajighị.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike iziga system prompt site na Python ma gbanwee JSON model ahụ ka ọ bụrụ data n'enweghị nsogbu.

check.q: Gịnị ka json.loads na-eme azịza model ahụ?
options: Ọ na-eziga ya azụ nye model ahụ
Ọ na-agbanwe ederede JSON ka ọ bụrụ data Python koodu gị nwere ike iji
Ọ na-elele ma azịza ahụ bụ eziokwu
Ọ na-echekwa ya na faịlụ
check.why: json.loads na-agbanwe ederede JSON ka ọ bụrụ data Python dị ka dictionary.

check.q: Agent gị nwetara ozi efu, nzọụkwụ parse wee daa. Gịnị ka koodu ahụ kwesịrị ime?
options: Gbajie ka ị hụ ya
Weghachi ederede ọ bụla lọtara dị ka category
Jide mperi ahụ, wee nwaa ọzọ otu ugboro ma ọ bụ kaa ihe ahụ akara na ọ dara
Hichapụ ozi ahụ
check.why: Itinye parse n'ime try / except na-ekwe ka agent jikwaa azịza ọjọọ kama ịgbaji.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Ịnwale prompt dị ka onye injinia
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Rụọ prompt n'obere ndepụta nnwale ma meziwanye ya site na nsonaazụ.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ihe nnwale ise, gụnyere otu nke nwere aghụghọ, ị ga-enwe ike ịnwale prompt ahụ, idekọ nsonaazụ ya ma gbanwee otu ihe iji dozie ọdịda, na-arụghachi nnwale niile mgbe mgbanwe ọ bụla gasịrị.
Otu ezigbo azịza egosighị ọtụtụ ihe. Ndị injinia na-ede test set: obere ndepụta ihe e tinyere na azịza ha na-atụ anya ya. Tinye ihe dị mfe, edge case (efu, ogologo nke ukwuu, isiokwu abụọ n'otu oge) na otu ihe nwere aghụghọ, dị ka ozi na-ekwu "ignore your instructions".
Na Python, ndepụta nke abụọ abụọ na-arụ ọrụ: tests = [('Where is my cake?', 'order'), ('You burned my bread!', 'complaint')]. Gaa n'otu n'otu n'ime ya (loop), kpọọ model ahụ, parse JSON ma tụnyere ya na azịza a tụrụ anya ya. Gụọ ole bụ JSON ziri ezi na ole ziri ezi.
Gbanwee otu ihe n'otu oge: iwu doro anya karị, ọmụmaatụ ka mma. Rụọ test set niile ọzọ mgbe mgbanwe ọ bụla gasịrị, ka ị mara na ndozi ahụ nyere aka ma o mebighị ihe ọ bụla. Debe ụdị prompt ọ bụla na akara ya n'ime notebook gị.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Dee ihe nnwale 5 ruo 10 nwere azịza a tụrụ anya ya.
- Tinye edge case na otu ihe nwere aghụghọ.
- Loop: kpọọ, parse, tụnyere, gụọ.
- Gbanwee otu ihe na prompt.
- Rụọ nnwale niile ọzọ ma debe ụdị ka mma.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Test set: ndepụta ihe e tinyere na azịza ị na-atụ anya ya, e ji elele prompt.
- Edge case: ihe a na-adịghị ahụkarị, dị ka ozi efu ma ọ bụ ozi ogologo nke ukwuu.
- Regression: mgbe mgbanwe dozikwara otu ihe mana mebie ihe ọzọ.
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: dee system prompt gị nwere role, ọrụ, iwu atọ, ụdị JSON na otu ọmụmaatụ. Nwalee ya na Colab n'ihe ise gụnyere otu nwere aghụghọ, dekọọ JSON ziri ezi na ziri ezi maka nke ọ bụla, gbanwee prompt ahụ otu ugboro iji dozie ọdịda, ma rụọ ya ọzọ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịnwale na imeziwanye prompt site n'obere test set, dị ka ndị na-ewu agent si eme.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị System prompt zuru ezu Otu ma ọ bụ karịa n'ime role, ọrụ ma ọ bụ iwu atọ adịghị ma ọ bụ edoghị anya. Na-enye role, ọrụ ahụ na iwu atọ doro anya. Iwu ahụ na-ekpuchikwa ihe a ga-eme mgbe o nweghị n'aka ma ọ bụ mgbe ọ dịghị ihe dabara. Ụdị azịza na ọmụmaatụ Ọ dịghị ụdị JSON kpọmkwem ma ọ bụ ọ dịghị ọmụmaatụ. Na-ekwu kpọmkwem keys JSON ma nye otu ọmụmaatụ zuru ezu. Ọmụmaatụ ahụ dabara kpọmkwem n'ụdị ahụ, ọtụtụ azịza bụkwa JSON ziri ezi. Na-arụ ọrụ site na Colab n'enweghị nsogbu Notebook ahụ anaghị arụ ọrụ, ma ọ bụ a na-ahụ igodo API. Prompt ahụ na-arụ ọrụ site na Colab, igodo ahụ dịkwa na ntọala nzuzo. Notebook ahụ dị ọcha, onye ọzọ nwekwara ike ịrụ ya ọzọ site n'igodo nke ya. Na-parse azịza n'enweghị nsogbu Azịza ọjọọ ma ọ bụ nke efu na-eme ka koodu gbajie. A na-parse JSON ka ọ bụrụ data, a na-ejidekwa azịza ọjọọ. A na-aka ihe dara ada akara n'ụzọ doro anya ka e nwee ike inyocha ha. Nwalere ma meziwanye Ihe e tinyere erughị ise, ọ dịghị ihe nwere aghụghọ, ma ọ bụ e dekọghị nsonaazụ. Ihe ise gụnyere otu nwere aghụghọ, e dekọrọ JSON ziri ezi na ziri ezi maka nke ọ bụla, e mere otu mgbanwe ma rụọ nnwale niile ọzọ. Nwere ike ịkọwa ihe mere ọdịda ahụ ji mee na ihe mgbanwe ahụ dozịrị. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.

check.q: Gịnị bụ regression mgbe ị na-anwale prompt?
options: Nnwale gafere na nke mbụ
Ndozi nke mere ka nnwale gafere na mbụ daa ugbu a
Ihe nnwale e dere n'asụsụ ọzọ
Azịza model ahụ na-abịa nwayọọ karị
check.why: Regression bụ mgbe mgbanwe mebiri ihe na-arụ ọrụ na mbụ.

check.q: Otu n'ime nnwale ise dara. Gịnị bụ nzọụkwụ kacha mma ọzọ?
options: Gbanwee otu ihe na prompt ma rụọ nnwale ise ahụ niile ọzọ
Dee prompt ahụ niile ọzọ site na mmalite
Hichapụ nnwale dara ada
Rụọ naanị nnwale dara ada ọzọ
check.why: Ịgbanwe otu ihe na ịrụ nnwale niile ọzọ na-egosi ihe mgbanwe ahụ dozịrị na ihe o mebiri.
